cost_rule: Retain every alternating pair. Report descriptive wall time, throughput, traced controller memory and export/audit cost. No speedup gate or timing-based selection.
limits: Declared local executor source files only, under stable trusted installation/database ownership.
Not loaded-bytecode attestation, full dependency/Python-version provenance, coordinated-tampering protection or a hostile-code sandbox.
No automatic runtime migration; original runtime remains necessary to resume an enrolled store.
No model inference, training, independently improved task success, or retired confirmation data.
primary_rule: Reject a changed or incomplete declared executor source bundle before claim, worker refresh/grading, and publication. Rejection preserves job/attempt/event state. After real process exit, changed-runtime resume is refused; restoring the enrolled runtime resumes token 2 and a raw-export replay matches its executor bytes. The unchanged control succeeds.
stage: Development regression of an observed source-provenance defect; frozen before paired costs. Not model/task confirmation.
